TITLE: Saju × MBTI, side by side
MBTI_STYLE_NOTE: Your own MBTI pick — not an official test result

outward.label: Reaching outward
outward.body: Your chart leans outward. You settle into things most easily when you start, move, and bump into the world.

inward.label: Gathering inward
inward.body: Your chart leans inward. You do best when you sort things out alone and move once it feels certain.

balanced.label: Both sides at once
balanced.body: Your chart doesn't lean hard either way. Some days you step out, some days you pull back.

match.headline: Both stories point the same way
match.body: Your own pick and your chart agree on the direction. That usually reads as a fairly steady way of showing up.

contrast.headline: Your chart and your MBTI disagree
contrast.body: Your chart says outward, but you may feel recharged on the inside. You might have shaped your outside to fit a role, or a different side comes out when you're comfortable.

balanced.headline: Hard to pin to one side
balanced.body: Neither one points firmly one way. It may sit better as a range you move around than a fixed label.

DAY_STEM_OVERLAY.甲: There is a pull to grow straight upward.
DAY_STEM_OVERLAY.乙: There is a pull to bend without breaking.
DAY_STEM_OVERLAY.丙: There is a pull to shine and make things visible.
DAY_STEM_OVERLAY.丁: There is a pull to burn small but long.
DAY_STEM_OVERLAY.戊: There is a pull to stand firm and hold ground.
DAY_STEM_OVERLAY.己: There is a pull to tend and level things out.
DAY_STEM_OVERLAY.庚: There is a pull to cut through and clear a path.
DAY_STEM_OVERLAY.辛: There is a pull to refine until it is clear.
DAY_STEM_OVERLAY.壬: There is a pull to flow wide and hold a lot.
DAY_STEM_OVERLAY.癸: There is a pull to seep in and nourish quietly.

layer.title: Outside and inside differ
layer.body: How you look to others and how you are alone don't have to match. Neither one needs to be declared the real you.

environment.title: Shaped by role
environment.body: If a role long pushed your outside one way, that may not reflect your inside. Notice where you feel lighter after a change of scene.

hidden.title: The hidden grain
hidden.body: Watch which way you lean just before a decision. Feeling charged after people, or only settled alone, is a good clue.

complement.title: Practised on purpose
complement.body: Sometimes people train the opposite side by choice. Your outside becomes the way effort built, your inside the way you drift when relaxed.

HOURLY_NOTICE: Birth time was unknown, so the hour pillar was not used. Signals that need the hour have been left out.
DISCLAIMER: A for-fun reflection. This is not an assessment, and there are no right or wrong answers.
